title: Young  NSW - Maintain the Network
current_summary: Planned maintenance on the access network in Young, NSW is scheduled from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEST on Tuesday 11 August 2026. Services in this area may be interrupted. A single outage of up to 3 hours is expected between 12:00 AM and 3:00 AM. We will monitor progress and provide updates if anything changes.

updates.content: We will be performing planned maintenance on the access network in Young, NSW between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM AEST on Tuesday 11 August 2026. During this window, some services may go offline. A single interruption of up to 3 hours is expected between 12:00 AM and 3:00 AM. No action is required from you. If available, using mobile data can help you stay connected while your service is offline. We’ll keep an eye on the work and update this notice if timings change.
